payload.author: claude
payload.body: Shipped throughput + resource-growth suite in @fricken/bench (bench/src/throughput.ts) on branch feat/fr97-98-benchmarks. runThroughput / pnpm bench:throughput drives a sustained append/upsert workload across N concurrent WS connections; emits ops/sec (appends/upserts/total) plus a resources section sampling process.memoryUsage (rss/heapUsed), SQLite db byte size + per-table row counts (stream_events/objects/idempotency_keys via store.rawDatabase()), and idempotency-cache rows before vs after, with deltas. Growth omitted for external --http-url/--ws-url targets (no store access). Covered by apps/server/tests/bench-suites.test.ts. Gate green: typecheck exit 0; server vitest 843 passed | 45 skipped.
